mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quest WHERE dungeon_id = #{dungeonId} ORDER BY order_index
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quest (dungeon_id, attraction_id, title, description, order_index, status, created_at) VALUES (#{dungeonId}, #{attractionId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{orderIndex}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT q.id, q.title, q.description, q.dungeon_id FROM quest q WHERE q.dungeon_id IN ( SELECT p.dungeon_id FROM party p JOIN party_member pm ON p.id = pm.party_id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY p.dungeon_id ) ORDER BY q.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
